mutations.label: PI4 the new-instance check compares the wrong way round, so it reports STALE entries as new arrivals and lets a genuine new instance through unnoticed

PI5 EXPECTED-MISSED (self-reference, not a gap): this replaces the INPUT of the ratchet's own assertion with `[]`, and no test can catch a mutation that stops that same test from checking -- a ratchet cannot be verified by mutating itself. What IS verified is the function it calls: `stale_entries` has four driven tests covering both directions, added by #1203pg after a reversed-comparison mutation was MISSED because both set differences are empty in the healthy state.

PI6 the ratchet stops seeing unittest-style assertions, which is how 14 instances of this very shape hid from its first version -- one of them in the file that introduced the ranking this ratchet came out of
